# ALLONE — All Systems. One Intelligence.
> AI automation agency in Tbilisi, Georgia and Brussels, Belgium. Founded in 2025, we build custom AI chatbots, workflow automation, and high-performance websites. Our AI-native delivery reduces implementation costs by up to 90%.

## About ALLONE
ALLONE is an AI automation agency that converges all business systems into one intelligent layer. We serve clients across e-commerce, real estate, finance, manufacturing, fashion, and hospitality worldwide. Team operates in English and Georgian from two offices.

## Services
- **AI Chatbots**: Multi-channel deployment (WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, web). Natural language understanding, CRM integration, 24/7 support. Typical delivery: 1-2 weeks.
- **Custom AI Solutions**: Machine learning models, computer vision, NLP pipelines, AI agents. Typical delivery: 4-8 weeks.
- **Workflow Automation**: Document processing, lead scoring, invoice automation, CRM/ERP integration using n8n and custom pipelines. Typical delivery: 2-4 weeks.
- **Website Development**: Next.js, React, TypeScript. SEO-optimized, Core Web Vitals compliant, e-commerce capable. Typical delivery: 4-8 weeks.
- **Strategy & Consulting**: AI readiness assessment, implementation roadmaps, ROI analysis, team training.

## Engagement Models
- **Project-based**: Fixed scope and timeline with milestone payments
- **Retainer**: Ongoing development and optimization at monthly rate
- **Consulting**: Hourly or daily rate for advisory and assessment

## Portfolio (Selected Projects)
- Equivalenza Georgia — E-commerce platform for international perfume brand
- DataRooms — AI-powered investor data rooms with intelligent document search
- HostWise — Property management SaaS with automated guest communication
- KaoTenders — B2B industrial tender platform with AI matching
- FIFTY — Community innovation space digital platform
- Chaos Concept — Fashion and art concept store e-commerce

## Technology Stack
Frontend: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS | AI/ML: Custom models, LLM integration, RAG | Backend: Node.js, Python, Supabase, PostgreSQL | Cloud: Vercel, AWS | Automation: n8n, Zapier
